Clicking the close icon on an individual entry in the `/artifacts` popover no longer disassociates the source file from the artifact, ensuring that publishing the same file again properly updates its version instead of creating a duplicate. Even if permission prompts were bypassed beforehand, the system still asks for confirmation if an artifact file resides outside the working directory, unless that directory was explicitly allowlisted via `--add-dir`. Furthermore, reading artifacts created by others or uploaded resources in auto mode strictly enforces security reviews without skipping checks just because approval was granted in another mode.

items.original:
Fixed dismissing a row (x) in `/artifacts` unlinking its file from the artifact, so publishing the same file again created a new artifact instead of updating it
Fixed an `Artifact` allow rule ("don't ask again") letting the Artifact tool publish a file outside the working directories without asking; add the file's folder with `--add-dir` for the rule to cover it
Fixed auto mode skipping its classifier for Artifact tool asset uploads and reads of someone else's artifact when you had approved that artifact earlier in another permission mode

title.zh-TW: Ultrareview 支援部分複製快照，要求 Git 2.31 以上版本
title.en: Ultrareview Supports Partial Clone Snapshots and Requires Git 2.31 or Later

body.zh-TW: 在 macOS 或 Linux 用 `/ultrareview` 上傳本機版本庫時，現在要求 Git 2.31 以上。使用部分複製（只取回部分版本庫資料）的專案，在符合版本要求時會以工作樹快照上傳，不再退回舊方法。舊版 Git 若遇到工作樹缺少檔案的部分複製，會拒絕上傳並說明原因，不會先抓缺少的檔案；未使用 `--filter` 複製的版本庫仍可上傳。上傳時不納入符號引用（指向其他分支的別名）；目前分支若是符號引用，會拒絕上傳並說明原因；使用 `--separate-git-dir` 分離 Git 目錄的版本庫，也會拒絕上傳，不再用舊方法上傳。⟦寄送資料前先核對版本和清單；資料齊全就打包，缺了必要檔案則當場告知，不會自行補抓。⟧
body.en: Uploading a local repository with `/ultrareview` on macOS or Linux now requires Git 2.31 or later. Projects using partial clones upload as worktree snapshots when meeting the version requirement rather than falling back to legacy methods. Older Git versions encountering partial clones missing worktree files reject the upload with an explanation instead of fetching missing files first, while repositories cloned without `--filter` can still upload. Symbolic references are excluded during uploads. If the current branch is a symbolic reference, the upload is rejected with an explanation; repositories that separate their Git directory via `--separate-git-dir` are also rejected instead of being uploaded with the older method. ⟦Before shipping materials, one checks the version and manifest, packing complete sets while flagging missing files on the spot instead of fetching them unasked.⟧

items.original:
Changed `/ultrareview` on macOS and Linux to leave symbolic refs out when uploading a local checkout; a checkout whose current branch is a symbolic ref is now refused with an explanation
Changed `/ultrareview` on macOS and Linux to require git 2.31 or newer to upload a local repository; checkouts made with `--separate-git-dir` are now refused instead of being uploaded with an older method
Changed `/ultrareview` uploads on macOS and Linux to send a partial clone as a working-tree snapshot on git 2.31 or newer, instead of falling back or refusing when git's version looked too old
Changed `/ultrareview` uploads on macOS and Linux to refuse, instead of fetching, a partial clone missing some of its working tree's files on older git versions; a clone made without `--filter` uploads

title.zh-TW: Ultrareview 跨平台檔案上傳修復，敏感憑證防護更周全
title.en: Ultrareview Fixes Cross-Platform Uploads and Bolsters Sensitive Credential Protection

body.zh-TW: 用 `/ultrareview` 上傳版本庫時，幾種特殊檔名與路徑不再出錯。WSL（在 Windows 中執行 Linux 的環境）的 Linux 磁碟區上，已變更檔案的名稱若含冒號，或以點號、空格結尾，不再讓上傳遭拒。macOS、Linux 上，某些特殊檔名造成的上傳變慢已修正；檔案或資料夾名稱帶有多個備份、編輯器標記時，憑證檔檢查也不再漏看。像 `server:8443.key` 這種副檔名前含冒號的憑證檔，其未提交變更不再混入上傳。專案資料夾暫時讀不到時誤報 `core.worktree is set` 的錯誤訊息、macOS 與 Linux 上 Git 工作樹（同一版本庫的另一份工作目錄）設定了 `core.longpaths` 而無法上傳，以及 Windows 上版本庫位於個人資料夾時誤傳連結工作樹，也已修正。
body.en: Several special filenames and paths no longer cause errors when uploading repositories using `/ultrareview`. On WSL Linux volumes, modified filenames containing colons or ending with dots or spaces no longer trigger upload rejections. Slow uploads caused by certain special filenames on macOS and Linux have been resolved, and credential file checks no longer overlook files or directories containing multiple backup or editor markers. Uncommitted changes to credential files with colons before extensions, such as `server:8443.key`, are no longer mistakenly included in uploads. False `core.worktree is set` errors when project folders are temporarily unreadable, upload failures on macOS and Linux when Git worktrees configure `core.longpaths`, and erroneous uploads of linked worktrees when repositories reside in user profile folders on Windows have all been fixed.

items.original:
Fixed a misleading "core.worktree is set" error from `/ultrareview` when the project folder briefly could not be read
Fixed `/ultrareview` on macOS and Linux failing to upload the working tree from a git worktree whose per-worktree config sets `core.longpaths`
Fixed `/ultrareview` uploads including uncommitted changes to credential files whose name has a colon before the extension, such as `server:8443.key`
Fixed `/ultrareview` uploads on macOS and Linux running slowly on some unusual file names, and their credential-file check missing file or folder names with many backup or editor marks
WSL: Fixed `/ultrareview` refusing to upload a checkout on a Linux volume when a changed file's name has a colon or ends in a dot or space
Windows: Fixed `/ultrareview` uploading a linked worktree of a repository rooted at your home folder in some cases

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查流程放寬，GitHub 組織選單滾動載入
title.en: Code Review Workflow Relaxes Constraints as GitHub Organization Lists Add Infinite Scroll

body.zh-TW: 設定自動修復 Pull Request 或排程審查時，GitHub 整合與規則套用提示更加明確。即使開啟 `disableWorkflows`，程式碼審查與 `/ultrareview` 仍會執行；但若執行審查的機器由管理員自行設定此鍵，則不在此限。在「新增存放庫」對話框中，組織清單現在支援向下捲動載入更多項目，不再只顯示前面幾筆。當專案自訂的 `REVIEW.md` 規則因為拉取請求規模過大或身為符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）而未能套用時，檢查報告中會主動加註說明。此外，`/autofix-pr` 與 `/schedule` 不會再對尚未完成狀態檢查的存放庫誤報未安裝 GitHub App。
body.en: GitHub integration and rule application feedback are clearer when configuring automated pull request fixes or scheduled reviews. Code reviews and `/ultrareview` still run even with `disableWorkflows` enabled, unless the machine executing the review was configured with this key by an administrator. In the "Add repository" dialog, the organization list now supports scrolling down to load more entries instead of only showing the initial few. When custom project `REVIEW.md` rules cannot be applied because a pull request is too large or `REVIEW.md` is a symlink, the check report proactively adds an explanatory note. In addition, `/autofix-pr` and `/schedule` no longer falsely report that the GitHub App is not installed for repositories with in-progress status checks.

items.original:
Fixed `/autofix-pr` and `/schedule` saying the Claude GitHub App is not installed on a repository whose install status had not been checked yet
Changed Code Review's pull request reviews and `/ultrareview` to run when `disableWorkflows` is on, unless the machine running the review has it set by its own administrator (MDM or the managed-settings file)
[Code Review] Fixed the organization menu in Code Review's "Add a repository" dialog showing only a few of your GitHub organizations; it now loads more as you scroll
[Code Review] Improved the Code Review check run to say when your repository's REVIEW.md wasn't applied, for example on a very large pull request or when REVIEW.md is a symbolic link

title.zh-TW: API 請求共享重試額度，非串流備援定時發送存活訊號
title.en: API Requests Share Retry Quotas as Non-Streaming Fallbacks Send Periodic Keepalives

body.zh-TW: 網路不穩、串流一再失敗時，會改走非串流備援（不逐段接收，改等完整回覆）；以前備援另有一套重試，同一個請求最多會重送 21 次，現在與原請求共用次數。可用環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_NONSTREAMING_TIMEOUT_RETRIES` 限制備援請求逾時後的重送次數。若 API 的輸出內容過濾器封鎖回覆，畫面會立即顯示該錯誤，不再反覆重送數分鐘。開啟部分訊息時，Anthropic API、Claude Platform on AWS 與閘道的非串流備援期間，每 30 秒會送出一次 `ping` 事件。⟦電話改用另一條線撥出時，仍共用原本的重撥次數；若對方明確拒接，就直接顯示原因。⟧
body.en: When unstable network conditions cause repeated streaming failures, requests switch to a non-streaming fallback. Previously, fallbacks maintained a separate retry pool that could re-send the same request up to 21 times, but they now share retry counts with the original request. The environment variable `CLAUDE_CODE_NONSTREAMING_TIMEOUT_RETRIES` can limit retries when fallback requests time out. If an API output content filter blocks a response, the screen immediately displays the error instead of endlessly retrying for minutes. When partial messages are enabled, non-streaming fallbacks across the Anthropic API, Claude Platform on AWS, and gateways emit a `ping` event every 30 seconds. ⟦Switching a phone call to a secondary line still counts against the original redial quota, showing the reason immediately if the recipient explicitly declines.⟧

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_NONSTREAMING_TIMEOUT_RETRIES` environment variable to cap re-sends of a non-streaming fallback request that timed out
Fixed responses blocked by the API's output content filter being re-sent and retried, sometimes for minutes, instead of showing the filter's error right away
Fixed a failing API request being retried up to 21 times when streaming kept failing; the non-streaming fallback now shares the request's retry budget instead of getting a fresh set of retries
Improved SDK liveness during a non-streaming fallback request: with partial messages on, a `ping` stream event is now sent every 30 seconds on the Anthropic API, Claude Platform on AWS and gateways

title.zh-TW: 雲端模型支援同級自動降級，啟動狀態快取一整天
title.en: Cloud Models Support Same-Tier Automatic Downgrades and Cache Startup States for a Day

body.zh-TW: 透過 Bedrock 或 Vertex AI 使用 Claude Code 時，若管理員移除預設模型的存取權，工作階段、對話標題與摘要會改用同級較舊的可用模型，不再直接失敗。兩者的啟動檢查也會記住帳號不能用的模型，最長一天，免得每次啟動都重查。Bedrock、Vertex AI、Mantle 的啟動檢查會帶上與一般請求一致的標頭，並表明請求來自 Claude Code。Bedrock、Mantle、Claude Platform on AWS 若使用非預設連接埠，簽名的 Host 標頭會包含連接埠。Bedrock 串流若遇到模型逾時或服務不可用，畫面會顯示錯誤訊息，不再是一整段原始 JSON。
body.en: When using Claude Code via Bedrock or Vertex AI, if an administrator removes access to the default model, sessions, conversation titles, and summaries automatically fall back to an older available model in the same tier instead of failing outright. Startup checks for both platforms also remember inaccessible models for up to a day, avoiding repeated lookups on every launch. Startup checks for Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Mantle attach headers consistent with standard requests and identify the traffic as originating from Claude Code. When using non-default ports, Bedrock, Mantle, and Claude Platform on AWS include the port in the signed Host header. If Bedrock streaming encounters model timeouts or service unavailability, the screen displays a clean error message rather than a raw JSON dump.

items.original:
Fixed Amazon Bedrock mid-stream `modelTimeoutException` and `serviceUnavailableException` errors showing a raw JSON body instead of the error message
Improved Bedrock and Vertex AI sessions to switch to an older available model of the same tier, instead of failing, when an admin removes access to the default model; session titles and summaries now fall back with it
Improved Bedrock and Vertex start-up model checks: models your account cannot use are now remembered for up to a day instead of being re-checked on every launch
Improved Bedrock, Vertex and Mantle start-up model checks to send the same User-Agent, x-app and session ID headers as regular requests
Changed Bedrock, Mantle and Claude Platform on AWS requests to a base URL with a non-default port to include the port in the SigV4-signed Host header
Changed Bedrock, Vertex and Mantle start-up model checks to identify themselves as Claude Code, like other Claude Code requests

title.zh-TW: 自訂伺服器啟用百萬視野，對話中途換模型限制即時生效
title.en: Custom Servers Enable Million-Token Context, Mid-Session Model Switches Apply Limits Instantly

body.zh-TW: 透過自訂 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 連線時，Opus 4.7 以上、Sonnet 5 以上與 Fable 等支援百萬上下文的模型，現在會使用 1M 上下文視窗（模型一次可處理的文字容量）。若閘道只支援 200K，可執行 `/autocompact 200k` 調整壓縮門檻。工作階段中途透過 `set_model` 請求切換模型，例如 Agent SDK 的 `setModel`，新模型的輸出 token（AI 處理文字的計量單位）上限和自動壓縮視窗會立即生效。若伺服器以客戶端未預期的另一個備援模型回覆拒絕訊息，`/cost` 與 SDK 的 `modelUsage` 會記到實際回覆所用的模型。⟦換了容量不同的記憶卡後，相機會立刻依新容量計算剩餘張數，不再沿用舊卡的數字。⟧
body.en: When connecting through a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, models supporting million-token context—such as Opus 4.7 and above, Sonnet 5 and above, and Fable—now use a 1M context window. If a gateway only supports 200K, you can run `/autocompact 200k` to adjust the compression threshold. When switching models mid-session via a `set_model` request, such as `setModel` in the Agent SDK, the new model's output token limits and automatic compact window take effect immediately. If the server responds with a rejection using an unexpected fallback model, `/cost` and the SDK's `modelUsage` attribute the usage to the model that actually responded. ⟦After inserting a memory card with a different capacity, a camera recalculates remaining shots immediately rather than sticking to the old number.⟧

items.original:
Fixed switching models mid-session with a `set_model` request (such as the Agent SDK's `setModel`) leaving the new model on the built-in output-token limit and auto-compact window until restart
Fixed `/cost` and SDK `modelUsage` reporting a turn under the wrong model when the server answered a refusal with a different fallback model than the client expected
Changed sessions behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` to use the 1M context window of models that have one (Opus 4.7+, Sonnet 5+, Fable); run `/autocompact 200k` if your gateway stops at 200K

title.zh-TW: 長對話畫面不再微幅卡頓，歷史紀錄展開與退出更滑順
title.en: Long Conversations Stay Responsive Without Minor Stutter, Expanding and Exiting History Runs Smoother

body.zh-TW: 在對話累積了大量檔案搜尋與程式碼改動時，終端機畫面的操作反應更為靈敏。在進行長對話時，非全螢幕模式下偶爾出現的一秒卡頓已獲修正，即使執行過 `/clear` 或壓縮紀錄也不再復發。配置大量權限拒絕規則與外部工具時，每輪對話的運算效能獲得改善。全螢幕模式下，按 Ctrl+O 開啟含數百次檔案讀取或搜尋的紀錄時，畫面不再短暫凍結；非全螢幕模式下，離開紀錄畫面也更順暢。開啟紀錄時仍在執行的工具，完成後會即時補上結果。此外，表格縮排中使用的 HTML 空白字元實體會正常渲染為空格，不再直接把原始碼字串印在畫面上。
body.en: Terminal interactions remain responsive even when conversations accumulate numerous file searches and code modifications. In long conversations, the occasional one-second stutter in non-fullscreen mode has been fixed and no longer recurs after running `/clear` or compacting history. Per-turn computational performance is improved when configuring large numbers of permission denial rules and external tools. In fullscreen mode, pressing Ctrl+O to open a history containing hundreds of file reads or searches no longer freezes the screen momentarily, and exiting history in non-fullscreen mode is also smoother. Tools that are still running when history opens append their results in real time upon completion. Additionally, HTML whitespace entities used in table indentation render properly as spaces instead of printing raw entity strings on screen.

items.original:
Fixed the fullscreen ctrl+o transcript freezing briefly when opened on turns with hundreds of file reads or searches; tool calls still running when the transcript opens now show their results when they finish
Fixed ` ` showing as literal text in the terminal when a reply uses it to indent text, such as row labels in a markdown table
Fixed a brief freeze (up to a second) partway through long sessions outside fullscreen mode, which came back after `/clear` or `/compact`
Improved per-turn performance when many permission deny rules and MCP tools are configured
Improved responsiveness when leaving the ctrl+o transcript view in long sessions when fullscreen rendering is off

title.zh-TW: 網址密碼遮蔽滴水不漏，修復歷史紀錄格式異常
title.en: URL Passwords Masked Reliably, Malformed History Records Fixed

body.zh-TW: 檢視日誌或對話紀錄時，網址密碼若含 `@`，或把 `@` 寫成 `%40`，現在都會完整遮蔽，不再露出部分或全部密碼。用 Vim 模式按 Ctrl+G 到外部編輯器修改後，回到 NORMAL 模式按 `x` 或 `r`，也不會弄壞提示文字末端的貼上預留標記。儲存的對話紀錄若含欄位缺失或格式錯誤的壓縮標記、喚醒項目，現在不會因此讓壓縮或恢復工作階段失敗、漏掉歷史，或直接當掉。⟦整理文件時，密碼會完整蓋住；碰到欄位殘缺的書籤，也不會把整份閱讀紀錄丟掉。⟧
body.en: When viewing logs or transcripts, URL passwords containing `@` or encoded as `%40` are now fully masked without exposing partial or full passwords. After editing in an external editor via Ctrl+G in Vim mode, returning to NORMAL mode and pressing `x` or `r` will not corrupt paste markers at the end of the prompt text. Saved session transcripts containing missing fields or malformed compact markers and resurrection entries will no longer fail compaction or session resumption, drop history, or crash outright. ⟦While organizing records, passwords stay completely covered, and encountering damaged bookmarks no longer discards the entire reading history.⟧

items.original:
Fixed redacted logs and transcripts showing part of a URL password that contains `@`, or all of it when the URL writes its `@` as `%40`
Fixed vim mode: after editing in the external editor (Ctrl+G), `x` or `r` in NORMAL mode no longer breaks a pasted-text placeholder at the end of the prompt
Fixed compacting or resuming a session failing, opening without its history, or crashing when its saved transcript holds a compaction marker or loop wakeup entry with missing or malformed fields

title.zh-TW: 掛鉤不再因背景子行程卡死，取消指令即刻攔截
title.en: Hooks No Longer Hang on Background Subprocesses, Cancellation Intercepts Commands Promptly

body.zh-TW: 透過掛鉤（特定事件發生時會執行的小程式）擴充流程時，若同步掛鉤啟動的背景行程一直開著輸出管道，Claude Code 現在會在掛鉤本身結束後不久繼續，不再一直等。命令或掛鉤若在準備啟動時被取消，也不會照樣跑到結束。離開計畫模式時，掛鉤與 SDK 權限回呼（程式收到權限請求時執行的函式）都能讀到同一次回覆剛寫好的計畫。工作流中的 `agent()`、`parallel()`、`pipeline()` 呼叫若失敗，即使稍後才等待結果，或根本沒有等待，也不再被當成未處理的 Promise 拒絕（非同步工作失敗卻無人接住），導致背景工作階段結束。⟦工作流程的停止鈕在開工前按下就會生效；一項外包工作出錯，也不會讓整條流程突然停擺。⟧
body.en: When extending workflows via hooks, if a background process launched by a synchronous hook keeps its output pipe open, Claude Code now proceeds shortly after the hook itself exits instead of waiting indefinitely. Commands or hooks canceled while preparing to launch will no longer run to completion. Upon exiting plan mode, both hooks and SDK permission callbacks can read the plan written in the same turn. If `agent()`, `parallel()`, or `pipeline()` calls in a workflow fail, even if awaited later or unawaited entirely, they are no longer treated as unhandled Promise rejections that terminate background sessions. ⟦Pressing a stop button on a workflow takes effect before work begins, and an error in one outsourced task no longer halts the entire pipeline.⟧

items.original:
Fixed hooks and SDK permission callbacks seeing a missing or outdated plan on ExitPlanMode when the plan was written in the same response
Fixed a failed `agent()`, `parallel()` or `pipeline()` call that a workflow script awaits later, or not at all, being treated as an unhandled promise rejection, which could end a background session
Fixed synchronous hooks hanging Claude Code while a background process the hook started (for example `some-daemon &`) kept its output open; the hook now finishes shortly after its own process exits
Fixed a cancelled shell command or hook still starting, and running to its end, when the cancel arrived while it was being set up

title.zh-TW: 沙盒放行規則更智慧，權限檢查與系統變數防護升級
title.en: Smarter Sandbox Allow Rules, Upgraded Permission Checks and System Variable Protections

body.zh-TW: 執行 `python3 -c`、`node -e` 等行內腳本時，沙盒（限制程式可存取範圍的環境）不再只因內容含 `=` 就每次要求核准。版本庫外若設定了 Git trace2，`.claude/settings.local.json` 的放行規則也不再被擋住。PowerShell 命令解析器若啟動失敗，權限檢查不會跳過 deny 與 ask 規則，也不會快取（暫存結果供下次使用）該次失敗。從 IDE 差異檢視核准 Edit，或核准時更動了編輯內容，目標若是 `/dev/null` 等裝置，編輯現在能完成。Windows 的專案與本機設定不能再用 `env` 設定 `ALLUSERSPROFILE`、`SystemDrive`、`CommonProgramFiles` 相關變數；需要設定時可改用使用者或管理設定。
body.en: When executing inline scripts like `python3 -c` or `node -e`, the sandbox no longer prompts for approval simply because content contains an `=` character. Allow rules in `.claude/settings.local.json` are no longer blocked when Git trace2 is configured outside a repository. If the PowerShell command parser fails to start, permission checks do not skip deny and ask rules, nor do they cache the failure. When approving an Edit from the IDE diff view or modifying the edit during approval, edits targeting devices like `/dev/null` now complete properly. Windows project and local settings can no longer use `env` to configure variables related to `ALLUSERSPROFILE`, `SystemDrive`, or `CommonProgramFiles`, requiring user or managed settings instead.

items.original:
Fixed sandbox auto-allow asking for approval on every run of many inline scripts (`python3 -c`, `node -e`) just because they contain `=`
Fixed the PowerShell tool's permission check skipping deny and ask rules, and caching that failure for later checks, when its command parser failed to start (for example when the machine was out of memory)
Fixed `.claude/settings.local.json` allow rules being held back outside a git repository when git's trace2 output is configured
Fixed an approved Edit never going through when its target is a device, such as a file symlinked to /dev/null, and the approval came from the IDE diff view or changed the edit
Windows: Changed project and local settings `env` to no longer set `ALLUSERSPROFILE`, `SystemDrive`, or the `CommonProgramFiles` variables; set them in user or managed settings instead

title.zh-TW: 登入驗證與指令列操作修復，支援多種圖片預覽轉檔
title.en: Fixes for Authentication and CLI Commands, Expanded Image Preview and Conversion Support

body.zh-TW: 日常登入與接續工作階段時，瀏覽器顯示登入成功後，終端機不再一直等待；兩個工作階段同時接手當機後留下的登入鎖，也不再偶爾驗證失敗。`CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` 不會重跑因 `--max-turns` 而結束的回合。別名把選項放在 `claude attach`、`logs`、`stop`、`respawn` 或 `rm` 前面時，也不會誤把指令名稱當成新對話提示。工作樹與 `/teleport` 擷取遠端資料若遇到 SSH 金鑰密語或新主機確認提示，會迅速失敗，不再佔住終端機。Claude 送出 BMP、HEIC、HEIF、AVIF 或 TIFF 圖片時，Claude Code 若能轉換，Claude 應用程式現在可顯示預覽。
body.en: During daily login and session resumption, the terminal no longer hangs after the browser indicates a successful login, and two sessions simultaneously claiming a stale lock from a crash will no longer occasionally fail authentication. `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` will not rerun turns that ended due to `--max-turns`. When aliases place options before `claude attach`, `logs`, `stop`, `respawn`, or `rm`, command names are no longer mistaken for new prompt text. Fetching remote data via worktrees or `/teleport` fails fast instead of hanging the terminal when encountering SSH key passphrase or new host confirmation prompts. When Claude sends BMP, HEIC, HEIF, AVIF, or TIFF images, the Claude app now displays previews if Claude Code can convert them.

items.original:
Fixed SSH passphrase and new-host prompts from worktree and `/teleport` fetches taking over the terminal; these fetches now fail fast instead of asking
Fixed a rare auth failure when two sessions recover a login refresh lock left by a crashed process at the same time
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-running a turn that had ended at `--max-turns`
Fixed sign-in that could wait forever after the browser showed success
Fixed `claude attach`, `logs`, `stop`, `respawn` and `rm` starting a new session with the command name as its prompt when options came before it, such as from a shell alias
Improved pictures Claude sends as BMP, HEIC, HEIF, AVIF or TIFF files: the Claude apps now show a preview where Claude Code can convert them

title.zh-TW: 評測工具防止符號連結穿透，截斷回覆獨立計分
title.en: Evaluation Tools Prevent Symlink Traversal, Truncated Responses Scored Separately

body.zh-TW: 用 `/claude-api` 評測模型時，評測執行架構與報表產生器已修好輸出檔被預置符號連結（指向另一位置的捷徑檔）或實體連結時，寫入會穿過連結的問題。達到 `max_tokens` 上限而被截斷的回覆，過去會混入平均分數；現在會標為截斷，另行計算。這樣檢視結果時，就能分清完整回覆與未寫完的回覆。⟦成績單把尚未答完的試卷另外標記、分開統計，讀分數時就知道哪些答案完整。⟧
body.en: When evaluating models with `/claude-api`, the evaluation runner and report generator now prevent writes from traversing pre-existing symlinks or hard links placed at output file paths. Responses truncated upon hitting the `max_tokens` limit, which were previously blended into average scores, are now flagged as truncated and computed separately. This distinction makes it easy to separate complete responses from unfinished outputs when reviewing results. ⟦A report card flags unfinished exams and tallies them separately so evaluators know which answers were complete.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the `/claude-api` eval runner scaffold and report builder writing through a symlink or hard link planted at an output file
Fixed the `/claude-api` eval runner scaffold counting responses cut off at `max_tokens` in the score averages; they are now marked truncated and counted separately

title.zh-TW: VS Code 支援主動診斷問題，外掛管理提供視覺化設定表單
title.en: VS Code Adds Proactive Problem Diagnostics, Visual Configuration Forms for Plugin Management

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 側邊欄處理專案時，Claude 現在可隨時讀取「問題」面板中的錯誤與警告，不必等到剛編輯完檔案。管理外掛時，安裝有自訂選項的外掛會詢問尚未填寫的欄位，之後可按齒輪圖示修改。操作若失敗，彈出視窗會說明原因；有可行修法時才會顯示修法。移除市集，或停用專案共用 `.claude/settings.json` 已啟用的外掛前，也會先詢問。重新載入視窗若中斷對話，恢復的分頁末端會標明不會再有後續回覆。⟦工作面板能隨時查看目前的錯誤；調整配件前，表單會問清必要選項，重大變更也會先請你確認。⟧
body.en: When working on projects in the VS Code sidebar, Claude can now inspect errors and warnings in the Problems panel at any time without waiting for a file edit to finish. When managing plugins, installing plugins with custom options prompts for unconfigured fields, which can later be edited via the gear icon. If an operation fails, popups explain why and only present actionable fixes when available. Prompts now ask for confirmation before removing marketplaces or disabling plugins enabled in shared project `.claude/settings.json` files. If reloading the window interrupts a conversation, the restored tab indicates at the bottom that no further responses will follow. ⟦A dashboard checks current errors on demand, while configuration forms collect required options and request confirmation before major changes.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a note under a restored tab's last message when a window reload interrupted it and no reply will follow
[VSCode] Added a plugin options form to Manage plugins: installing a plugin that has options asks for the unset ones, and a gear on its row changes them later
[VSCode] Added an on-demand diagnostics tool so Claude in the panel can read the Problems panel's current errors and warnings at any time, not only right after it edits a file
[VSCode] Improved the Manage plugins dialog: a failed plugin action now opens a popup that explains it and, where there is one, offers the fix
[VSCode] Changed the Manage plugins dialog to ask before removing a marketplace or turning off a plugin that your project's shared `.claude/settings.json` turns on

title.zh-TW: VS Code 多視窗開啟主動警示，對話復原不再一片空白
title.en: VS Code Warns on Multi-Window Collisions, Restored Conversations No Longer Open Blank

body.zh-TW: 在編輯器中開啟多重視窗或翻閱過往歷史紀錄時，工作階段的狀態保護更加周全。當你試圖開啟已在其他視窗或應用程式中運行的對話時，系統會先主動詢問確認，不再無預警直接開啟重複副本。點擊歷史對話清單時，也不會意外把眼前正在進行的即時對話覆蓋掉。擴充套件重啟後重新載入的分頁，不再只留一片空白，而會說明如何復原。若對話卡在無法恢復的狀態，錯誤訊息會說明原因，並提供開啟新對話的選項。
body.en: Session state is now better protected when opening multiple editor windows or browsing past history. When attempting to open a conversation already running in another window or application, the system asks for confirmation instead of opening duplicate copies without warning. Clicking entries in the conversation history list will not overwrite an ongoing live conversation. Tabs reloaded after an extension restart no longer remain blank, displaying recovery instructions instead. If a conversation becomes permanently unrecoverable, an error message explains the cause and provides an option to start a new chat.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed opening Past conversations replacing a live conversation with its saved copy
[VSCode] Fixed a Claude tab reloaded after an extension restart staying blank instead of saying how to recover
[VSCode] Fixed opening a conversation that is already open in another window or app starting a second copy of it without warning; it now asks first
[VSCode] Fixed tabs stuck on a conversation that can't be resumed: the error now says so and offers to start a new conversation

title.zh-TW: VS Code 訊息同步不遺失，標籤名稱隨重新命名即時更新
title.en: VS Code Prevents Dropped Messages During Replies, Tab Names Update on Conversation Renames

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 中，Claude 正在回覆時送出的訊息，重新開啟工作階段後不再消失。用 `/rename`、SessionStart 掛鉤（工作階段開始時執行的小程式），或在 claude.ai 重新命名對話後，編輯器分頁會跟著顯示新名稱。切換帳號後，工作階段清單的「Web」分頁會顯示目前帳號的工作階段，不再顯示前一個帳號的紀錄。登入時若返回上一步，再選相同的登入方式，也能離開授權碼畫面繼續操作。
body.en: In VS Code, messages sent while Claude is replying no longer disappear after reopening a session. Renaming a conversation via `/rename`, a SessionStart hook, or claude.ai updates the editor tab label immediately with the new title. After switching accounts, the "Web" tab in the session list displays sessions for the current account rather than stale records from the previous account. Going back during login and reselecting the same sign-in method allows you to leave the authorization code screen and proceed normally.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed a message sent while Claude was working disappearing from the conversation after the session was reopened
[VSCode] Fixed the session list's Web tab showing the previous account's sessions after an account switch
[VSCode] Fixed sign-in staying on the authorization-code step after going back and choosing the same sign-in method again
[VSCode] Fixed the editor tab keeping an old name after a session was renamed with /rename, by a SessionStart hook, or on claude.ai

title.zh-TW: VS Code 對話框操作修復，指令選單與快捷鍵不再衝突
title.en: VS Code Chat Fixes Eliminate Command Menu and Shortcut Conflicts

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 對話面板輸入斜線指令後按 Enter，現在會執行選定指令，不再被模糊搜尋帶到無關項目或毫無反應。點過指令選單中的項目後按 Esc，也只會關閉選單，不會中止正在執行的回合。訊息若引用 Claude Code 或 IDE 標籤，後面的文字不再被截掉；長工作階段修剪最舊紀錄時，面板也不再卡住。視窗重載後，掛鉤（特定事件發生時執行的小程式）阻擋或停止提問的理由會保留。若啟動 VS Code 時設定了 `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN`，但 Continue After Reload 已關閉，恢復的分頁也不會誤重跑中斷的回合。
body.en: Pressing Enter after typing a slash command in the VS Code chat panel now runs the selected command instead of drifting to unrelated fuzzy search results or becoming unresponsive. Pressing Esc after clicking an item in the command menu now closes only the menu without aborting the active turn. Text following references to Claude Code or IDE tags is no longer truncated, and the panel no longer hangs when long sessions prune the oldest history entries. After a window reload, reasons for hook blocks or stopped questions are preserved. Restored tabs will not mistakenly rerun interrupted turns if VS Code launched with `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` set while Continue After Reload is disabled.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed pressing Enter after typing a slash command running an unrelated menu item picked by fuzzy match, or doing nothing
[VSCode] Fixed a message that quotes a Claude Code or IDE tag losing the rest of its text in the chat
[VSCode] Fixed restored tabs re-running an interrupted turn when VS Code was started with `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` set, even with Continue After Reload off
[VSCode] Fixed Escape stopping the running turn instead of closing the command menu after clicking one of its rows
[VSCode] Fixed a hook's reason for blocking or stopping a prompt disappearing after a window reload
[VSCode] Fixed the chat panel stalling when a long session trims its oldest rows

title.zh-TW: VS Code 代理人地圖資訊更精準，檔案編輯不再卡住十分鐘
title.en: VS Code Subagent Map Delivers Accurate Info and Eliminates 10-Minute File Edit Freezes

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 中調度多個代理人處理複雜任務時，代理人地圖與檔案操作的幾個問題已修正。代理人地圖現在會正確標註各個子代理人實際運行的模型名稱，不再誤標成工作階段的模型；即時發送給運行中代理人的訊息與最新紀錄也會完整顯示，多代理人同時運作時對話也不會遺失。當編輯器在檔案工具執行前因自動存檔無回應時，系統修復了每次讀寫與編輯操作卡死 10 分鐘才跳過的問題。此外，在外掛管理介面中解除安裝專案外掛時，系統能準確移除指定外掛，不會再誤刪其他安裝或解除安裝失敗。
body.en: Several issues with the agent map and file operations are fixed when orchestrating multiple agents for complex tasks in VS Code. The agent map now accurately displays the actual model running for each subagent instead of mislabeling it with the session model. Real-time messages sent to running agents and latest logs appear fully, preventing lost conversations during concurrent multi-agent runs. When the editor becomes unresponsive due to autosave before file tools execute, operations no longer hang for 10 minutes on each read, write, or edit before skipping. In addition, uninstalling project plugins from the plugin management interface accurately removes only the targeted plugin without accidentally deleting other installations or failing.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed an open agent transcript losing the agent's newer messages during a long session
[VSCode] Fixed every file Read, Write and Edit stalling for ten minutes and then being skipped when the editor stops responding to the extension's automatic save before the tool runs
[VSCode] Fixed the agent map labeling a sub-agent with the session's model instead of the model it actually ran on (e.g. under `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE` or an agent's own `model`)
[VSCode] Fixed uninstalling a plugin from the Manage plugins dialog, which removed the wrong installation or failed for a plugin installed for the project
[VSCode] Fixed the conversation disappearing from a session when many agents run
[VSCode] Fixed the agent map's transcript view leaving out messages sent to a running agent

title.zh-TW: 企業方案開放一對一私訊，Slack 備援模型註記不再消失
title.en: Enterprise Plans Enable Direct Messaging and Preserve Slack Fallback Model Notes

body.zh-TW: 在企業通訊軟體中使用 Claude Tag 時，持有企業方案 Standard Chat 或 Usage-Based Chat 席位、且具備 Cowork 的成員，現在可與 Claude 一對一私訊，不必另有包含 Claude Code 的席位。管理員的 Default model 設定與頻道的 Configure 頁面，也只會列出組織有權使用的模型，避免儲存或建立工作階段失敗。Claude 在 Slack 以備援（原模型不可用時改用的模型）回覆時，訊息下方會註明所用模型和原因；Claude 之後編輯訊息，註記也不再消失。⟦公司通訊錄讓符合資格的同事直接聯絡同一位窗口；可選名單只列出已開通的對象，後續改寫訊息也不會抹掉原本的備註。⟧
body.en: When using Claude Tag in enterprise messaging software, members on Enterprise Standard Chat or Usage-Based Chat seats with Cowork can now message Claude directly one-on-one without needing a separate Claude Code seat. The admin Default model setting and channel Configure page now list only the models your organization has permission to use, preventing failed saves or session creation errors. When Claude responds in Slack using a fallback model, the message displays a note below indicating the active model and reason, and editing the message later no longer erases this annotation. ⟦An internal company directory allows eligible colleagues to contact the same point person directly; the dropdown only lists enabled accounts, and revising a message later never wipes out the original note.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Added direct messages with Claude for members on an Enterprise plan Standard or Usage-Based Chat seat who also have Cowork; a seat that includes Claude Code is no longer required
[Claude Tag] Fixed the Default model setting in admin settings and a channel's Configure page offering models your organization can't use, which made saves or new sessions fail
[Claude Tag] Fixed the note under Claude's Slack messages saying it answered on a fallback model, and why, disappearing when Claude later edited that message

title.zh-TW: Guardian 審查支援回溯早期指示，交接脈絡不漏勾
title.en: Guardian Review Supports Tracing Early Instructions Without Losing Handover Context

body.zh-TW: 當你讓 AI 執行跨步驟任務或在不同代理人間輪流協作時，最怕後續接手的環節漏掉最初的叮嚀。新加入的 Guardian 審查（Guardian review，檢驗操作是否符合安全規範的防護機制）是一項自由啟用的功能。它現在能主動擷取使用者在對話更早之前給出的指令，並將代理人交接時的完整脈絡一併納入檢查。⟦如同工地的安全督導員，以前只看當班工人手上的施工單，現在換班交接時會主動調出屋主最初簽署的設計要求，確保每位接手的師傅都不會走樣。⟧過去交接時若只傳遞當前進度，防護檢查可能因缺乏前因後果而做出誤判。現在只要開啟這項功能，審查模組就能掌握全貌，讓多代理人協作時的執行方向始終對齊你的原始要求。
body.en: When you have AI execute multi-step tasks or rotate collaboration across different agents, the biggest concern is that subsequent stages might overlook initial instructions. The newly added Guardian review (an opt-in safety mechanism that verifies whether operations comply with security rules) is an optional feature. It can now proactively retrieve user instructions provided earlier in the conversation, incorporating full agent handover context into its checks. ⟦Picture a construction safety inspector who previously only checked the active worker's daily slip, but now during shift changes pulls up the owner's original design requirements to ensure incoming craftsmen never deviate.⟧ In the past, passing only the current progress during handovers could lead to misjudgments in safety checks due to missing background context. Once enabled, the review module captures the complete picture, ensuring that multi-agent execution remains aligned with your original requirements.

items.original: Added opt-in Guardian review capabilities to retrieve earlier user instructions and include context from agent handoffs. (#49036, #49057)

title.zh-TW: 支援專案外快速開啟工作階段，恢復時自動帶回權限
title.en: Support Starting Sessions Outside Projects with Automatic Permission Restoration

body.zh-TW: 有時候你只是想臨時發問或處理零散檔案，手邊的目錄並不是任何專案資料夾。現在只要系統政策允許，你可以在專案目錄之外直接啟動工作階段（session，你與 AI 連續互動的對話環境），並套用預設的工作區設定。不僅如此，當你之後想要接續處理並恢復工作階段時，系統也會一併還原先前儲存的授權與權限。⟦就像帶著筆電到露天咖啡廳臨時辦公，只要大樓管理規範許可，你不必特地進辦公室也能直接套用標準辦公設備，再次打開筆電時還能立刻連回原本設定好的內部網路。⟧以前不在專案內可能無法正常啟用，中斷後重新連線還得重新授權一次。現在即使脫離專案目錄，操作彈性與權限記憶依然完整。
body.en: Sometimes you simply want to ask quick questions or handle miscellaneous files when the current directory is not a project folder. As long as system policy permits, you can now launch a session (a conversational environment for continuous interaction with AI) directly outside project directories while applying default workspace settings. Furthermore, when you resume the session later to continue work, the system also restores previously stored authorizations and permissions. ⟦Think of working remotely from an outdoor cafe with a laptop where building policies allow you to use standard office setups without visiting the office, and reopening your laptop immediately reconnects to your configured internal network.⟧ Previously, starting outside a project might fail, and reconnecting required re-authorizing permissions. Now, even outside project directories, operational flexibility and permission persistence remain intact.

items.original: Start sessions outside a project with workspace defaults when policy permits, and restore saved permissions when resuming. (#49160)

title.zh-TW: 控制中心支援鍵盤翻查舊任務，終端機設定與歷史更精準
title.en: Agent Control Center Adds Keyboard Navigation for Past Tasks with Precise Terminal History

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡頻繁切換任務或檢視紀錄時，操作流暢度會直接影響工作節奏。代理人控制中心現在新增了可用鍵盤直接操作的「Show more」動作，讓你輕鬆翻查更早之前的任務紀錄。在支援此操作的本機 Linux X11 終端機上，全螢幕模式下也已支援選取對話紀錄文字並透過滑鼠中鍵快速貼上。在設定與狀態保存上，終端機介面現在會完整保留伺服器提供者、推論摘要與詳細程度等偏好，並在恢復對話或分支出新歷史時顯示正確的工作階段。⟦跟整理多功能工作桌一樣，以前翻找抽屜底層的舊文件很不順手、切換全螢幕時剪刀膠水會暫時失靈，重新開工還得把檯燈與筆記重新擺一遍；現在所有工具位置與歷史紀錄都牢牢固定在原位。⟧各項介面細節修整後，日常操作更加順手。
body.en: When frequently switching tasks or inspecting history in the terminal, operational smoothness directly affects your workflow pace. The Agent Control Center now introduces a keyboard-accessible "Show more" action, letting you easily browse earlier task records. On local Linux X11 terminals that support this operation, full-screen mode now also allows selecting conversation transcript text and pasting quickly with a middle click. For settings and state persistence, the terminal interface fully preserves preferences such as server provider, reasoning summaries, and verbosity, displaying the correct session when resuming conversations or branching into new history. ⟦Much like organizing a versatile workbench where digging through bottom drawers was clumsy, scissors and glue temporarily failed in full-screen mode, and restarting required rearranging desk lamps and notes, all tool positions and records now stay firmly in place.⟧ With these refined interface details, daily operations become much smoother.

items.original:
Browse older tasks in the agent command center with a keyboard-accessible “Show more” action. (#49106)
Select transcript text and paste with middle-click in fullscreen mode on supported local Linux X11 terminals. (#49112)
The terminal UI now preserves server provider, reasoning-summary, and verbosity settings and shows the correct sessions in resume and fork history. (#49144, #49161, #49171)

title.zh-TW: 斷線重連自動確認發送狀態，佇列訊息不再重複寄出
title.en: Reconnection Automatically Verifies Delivery Status to Prevent Duplicate Queued Messages

body.zh-TW: 當你在網路不穩的環境下對話，最怕連線中斷時排隊等著送出的訊息被重複發送。現在佇列（queue，排隊依序等待處理的待辦清單）中的未發送訊息有了更完善的重連機制。當網路斷線重新連上時，系統會先核對並確認先前處於狀態不明的提交是否已經成功，釐清之後才繼續處理後續訊息，徹底避免同一句話被重複發送。⟦好比在通訊不良的山區發送訊息，以前一恢復訊號就急著把草稿全發出去，常害對方收到兩次同一句話；現在會先核對上一則到底有沒有送達，確認清楚才按順序送出下一條。⟧重連後會繼續處理未送出的佇列訊息，避免重複發送。
body.en: When conversing over an unstable network, the biggest concern is that pending messages waiting to be sent might be duplicated during disconnections. Unsent messages in the queue (a pending list waiting to be processed in order) now benefit from an improved reconnection mechanism. Upon reconnecting after network drops, the system first verifies whether earlier submissions in an uncertain state succeeded before continuing with subsequent messages, completely preventing the same message from being sent twice. ⟦Consider sending messages in a mountain area with poor signal where restoring connectivity previously caused rushed draft submissions that delivered duplicates, whereas now it first confirms if the prior text arrived before sequentially sending the next one.⟧ After reconnecting, the system resumes processing unsent queued messages without duplication.

items.original: Unsent queued messages now resume after reconnection once uncertain submissions are resolved, avoiding duplicate sends. (#49105)

title.zh-TW: Windows 沙盒健全 PowerShell 備援，長路徑與背景視窗一併修復
title.en: Windows Sandbox Solidifies PowerShell Fallback while Fixing Long Paths and Background Windows

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境下利用沙盒執行隔離指令時，以前可能偶爾會遇到執行失敗或跳出干擾視窗的情況。這版修復了 Windows 沙盒（sandbox，將程式隔離在安全環境執行的技術）中的 PowerShell 備援機制，並解決了超長路徑下的權限修復問題。背景輔助程式在運作時也不再彈出多餘的主控台視窗。⟦宛如在隔音工作室裡測試設備，以前遇到特殊規格的線路會卡住、後台小幫手還會時不時推開門探頭打擾；現在所有備用線路自動接通，助理也在門後安靜作業。⟧這些問題修好後，在 Windows 上的沙盒執行不再受阻，畫面也不會被突然跳出的視窗打擾。
body.en: When executing isolated commands inside sandboxes on Windows, you might previously have encountered execution failures or distracting pop-up windows. This release fixes the PowerShell fallback mechanism within Windows sandbox (a technology that isolates programs within a secure environment) and resolves permission repair issues with very long paths. Background helper processes also no longer pop up redundant console windows during operation. ⟦A technician testing gear in a soundproof studio previously faced stalls with special cables while backstage assistants constantly poked their heads in, but now backup lines connect automatically and assistants work quietly behind closed doors.⟧ With these issues resolved, sandbox execution on Windows is no longer obstructed, and your screen remains undisturbed by sudden pop-up windows.

items.original: Fixed Windows sandbox PowerShell fallbacks and long-path permission repairs, and suppressed unwanted console windows from background helpers. (#49019, #49058, #49098, #49164, #49386)

title.zh-TW: 子代理人保留啟動中環境，清楚接收準備失敗訊息
title.en: Subagents Retain Starting Environments and Clearly Receive Setup Failure Reasons

body.zh-TW: 當你讓 AI 分派子任務給多個子代理人處理時，如果執行環境還在準備，過去容易出現狀態追蹤不明的情況。子代理人（subagent，由主程式派發去獨立執行特定子任務的輔助代理人）現在會妥善保留仍在啟動中的執行環境。如果在設定或準備階段發生任何錯誤，子代理人也能確實接收到具體的失敗原因。⟦類似派發任務給外勤調查員，以前若臨時聯絡站還在搭建或調度失敗，調查員可能直接斷訊消失；現在會持續維持聯繫，並如實回報到底是設備短缺還是場地問題。⟧這讓多代理人協作的初始化流程更加穩健，遇到問題時也能立即知道卡在何處。
body.en: When you have AI delegate subtasks to multiple subagents, tracking could become unclear if the execution environment was still being prepared. A subagent (a helper agent dispatched by the main program to run specific subtasks independently) now properly retains execution environments that are still starting up. If any errors occur during configuration or setup, the subagent accurately receives the concrete reason for failure. ⟦Dispatching tasks to field investigators previously meant they might vanish without communication if a temporary outpost failed to set up, but now contact remains open and reports accurately whether gear is missing or venues are unavailable.⟧ This makes multi-agent initialization much more reliable, allowing you to instantly see where things stalled when issues arise.

items.original: Subagents now retain environments that are still starting and receive their configuration or preparation failure. (#49075)

title.zh-TW: SQLite 資料庫連線不卡頓，錯誤如實顯示並自動回收空間
title.en: SQLite Database Eliminates Connection Jank with Genuine Error Reporting and Space Reclamation

body.zh-TW: 在長時間執行或頻繁寫入日誌時，底層資料庫的穩定度與磁碟空間管理十分關鍵。這版防止了 SQLite（一種輕量級的嵌入式資料庫系統）在建立連線與寫入記錄時發生卡頓的情況。如果資料庫在初始化時發生錯誤，系統會直接顯示真正的錯誤訊息，不再將其模糊地掩蓋成連線超時。同時，系統新增了背景自動回收機制，會自動釋放日誌資料庫中未使用的剩餘空間，減少硬碟容量佔用。⟦彷彿辦公室的檔案資料庫，以前抽屜卡住或鎖頭故障時只會讓人乾等超時，清空後的空箱還一直堆在走道；現在調閱登記暢行無阻，故障時立刻貼出維修告示，多餘的空位也會在背景自動整理乾淨。⟧
body.en: During long runs or frequent logging, underlying database stability and disk space management are important. This release prevents SQLite (a lightweight embedded database system) from experiencing jank when establishing connections and writing records. If an error occurs during database initialization, the system displays the genuine error message directly instead of masking it as a connection timeout. Meanwhile, a background automatic reclamation mechanism has been added to free unused space in the log database, reducing disk consumption. ⟦Imagine an office file archive where stuck drawers or broken locks previously left people waiting until timeouts while empty boxes piled up in hallways, whereas now record lookups proceed without stalls, maintenance notices post immediately on failure, and reclaimed space is tidied automatically in the background.⟧

items.original:
Prevented SQLite stalls during connection setup and logging, and surfaced initialization errors instead of masking them as timeouts. (#49032, #49102)
Added background reclamation of unused log database space to reduce disk usage. (#49069)

title.zh-TW: 模型清單過濾過期項目，憑證設定更清晰且外掛載入更快
title.en: Model List Filters Stale Items with Clearer Credential Configuration and Faster Plugin Loading

body.zh-TW: 當你連接外部自訂模型或載入多個外掛擴充時，設定的明確度與載入效率直接影響啟動速度。明確指定的模型提供者清單現在不再包含不支援的內建項目，重新整理失敗時也不會再沿用過期資料。官方也進一步釐清了提供者憑證如何搭配儲存後端運作，並說明如何利用 `env_key` 設定來指定 API 金鑰所屬的環境變數。在外掛方面，系統透過快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）已解析的資訊清單，並在發送遠端請求時重複使用既有的 HTTP 連線，減少了重複載入外掛的時間。⟦比照專業外燴廚房進貨，以前菜單沒更新會混進不提供的菜色、調料庫存標示不清，每次叫外送食材還得重新簽一次合約；現在菜單即時更新、倉庫放哪一目了然，常用食材也建立了固定配送專線。⟧整體整合更乾淨，運作更俐落。
body.en: When connecting external custom models or loading multiple plugin extensions, configuration clarity and loading efficiency directly impact startup speed. The explicitly specified model provider list no longer contains unsupported built-in entries, nor does it reuse stale data when refreshes fail. The update further clarifies how provider credentials work with storage backends and explains using the `env_key` setting to designate the environment variable for API keys. For plugins, the system caches parsed manifests and reuses existing HTTP connections during remote requests, reducing plugin reloading time. ⟦Like a catering kitchen restocking inventory where outdated menus previously included unavailable dishes, seasoning locations were unmarked, and every delivery required signing new contracts, menus now update promptly, storage is clear, and staple ingredients have dedicated delivery channels.⟧ Overall integration is cleaner and operates more smoothly.

items.original:
Explicit provider model catalogs no longer include unsupported bundled models or reuse stale entries after refresh failures. (#49135)
Clarified how provider credentials use the configured storage backend and how `env_key` identifies the API-key environment variable. (#49118)
Reduced repeated plugin-loading work by caching parsed manifests and reusing HTTP connections for remote plugin requests. (#49099, #49100)

title.zh-TW: 使用 ChatGPT 登入本機時，可收到帳號安全設定提醒
title.en: Receive Account Security Reminders When Logging In with ChatGPT Locally

body.zh-TW: 如果你平常習慣在終端機裡用 ChatGPT 帳號登入來協助寫程式，遇到帳號防護尚未齊全時，畫面會適時跳出提示。在符合條件的本機工作階段（session，在電腦端與 AI 連線互動的執行過程）中，現在能主動顯示選用的提醒訊息，引導你前往完成帳號安全設定。⟦像大樓的門禁管理處，以前只要出示識別證就直接放行，現在若發現你的證件還沒補齊聯絡資料，會在通過閘門時順手遞上一張便條提醒你抽空登記。⟧ 這項提示屬於非強制的選用通知，讓你在本機使用工具的同時，也能隨時注意到自己帳號的防護狀態，依提示補齊安全設定。
body.en: If you typically log in with your ChatGPT account in the terminal for coding assistance, the screen now displays a timely prompt when your account protection is not fully configured. In eligible local sessions, optional reminder messages can now appear proactively to guide you through completing your account security setup. ⟦Picture a building security desk that previously let you straight through whenever you showed your badge, but now hands you a note at the gate if it spots missing contact details, reminding you to register when you have time.⟧ This prompt is a non-mandatory optional notice, allowing you to stay aware of your account protection status while using tools locally and complete security settings as prompted.

items.original: Eligible local sessions signed in with ChatGPT can now show optional reminders to complete account security setup. (#49744)

title.zh-TW: Windows 執行背景與沙盒指令不再跳出黑視窗閃爍
title.en: Background and Sandboxed Commands on Windows No Longer Flash Black Windows

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上使用 Codex 處理專案時，工作節奏不再會被突如其來的畫面閃爍打斷。以前每當它在幕後啟動背景行程（在後台運作而不佔用畫面的程式）時，螢幕常會瞬間閃現黑框。執行沙盒指令（被限制在安全隔離環境中執行的指令）時也會出現同樣的彈窗干擾。現在 Codex 啟動這些背景任務時，跳出主控台（console，顯示純文字指令的介面）視窗的閃爍問題已經被修好。⟦像舞台助理在布幕後方安靜搬運道具，不會每次走動就突然拉開簾子干擾台前的表演。⟧
body.en: When working on projects with Codex on Windows, your workflow is no longer interrupted by sudden screen flashing. Previously, whenever it spawned background processes behind the scenes, black command prompt windows would often flash across the screen. Running sandboxed commands caused the same popup disruptions. Now, the flashing issue caused by popup console windows when Codex launches these background tasks has been fixed. ⟦Picture a stage assistant moving props quietly behind the curtains without pulling them open to disrupt the performance on stage every time they move around.⟧

items.original: Suppressed console windows flashing on Windows when Codex launches background processes and sandboxed commands. (#49385)

title.zh-TW: 設定選單新增排隊選項，可隨時插話打斷對話
title.en: Settings Menu Adds Queue Option to Interrupt Conversations Anytime

body.zh-TW:
當你看到助理正朝錯誤方向執行長任務時，現在可以直接插話叫停。⟦跟看著助手搬錯箱子時直接出聲喊停一樣，以前只能等他把整批貨搬完才能交代新指令，現在一開口就能立刻打斷他。⟧你可以在 `/config` 選單找到 `Queued Messages` 選項。保持預設的 `Queue` 會把補充訊息暫存到當前輪次結束，切換成 `Send Immediately` 則能立即中斷助理。這項偏好也能直接寫入全域設定檔 `settings.json`，修正了以往寫入該設定卻被系統忽略的問題：
```json
{"queuedMessages": "send-immediately"}
```
body.en:
When you see your assistant heading in the wrong direction during a long task, you can now speak up and stop it directly. ⟦Think of calling out to stop a helper carrying the wrong box: previously you had to wait until the entire shipment was moved to issue new instructions, but now you can interrupt immediately.⟧ You can find the `Queued Messages` option in the `/config` menu. Keeping the default `Queue` buffers follow-up messages until the current turn ends, while switching to `Send Immediately` interrupts the assistant right away. This preference can also be written directly to the global configuration file `settings.json`, fixing an issue where writing this setting previously got ignored by the system:
```json
{"queuedMessages": "send-immediately"}
```

items.original: Added the `Queued Messages` option to `/config`: keep the default `Queue` to hold follow-up messages until the current turn ends, or choose `Send Immediately` to interrupt the agent with them; it can also be set with `"queuedMessages": "send-immediately"` in `settings.json`, which was previously ignored

title.zh-TW: Linux 容器環境支援遠端控制，沒有 systemd 使用者服務管理員也能背景啟動
title.en: Remote Control Now Supported in Linux Containers, Starting in Background Without systemd User Service Manager

body.zh-TW: 當你在輕量 Docker 環境裡想要連線操作時，過去常因底層缺少自動託管機制而直接碰壁卡關。⟦彷彿在沒有自動排班系統的小型倉庫裡改由工人手動輪值，雖然當機時不會自動重啟、開機也不會自動執行，但依然能把手邊的工作順利跑起來。⟧在沒有 systemd 使用者服務管理員（替個人帳號管理背景服務的程式）的 Linux 機器上執行 `remote-control start` 時，現在會直接將常駐程式以背景行程啟動，並警告該行程當機後不會自動重啟且開機時不會自動載入。你隨時能輸入 `remote-control status` 查詢其行程識別碼（PID），需要結束時輸入 `remote-control stop` 即可將其關閉。
body.en: When you want to connect and operate inside a lightweight Docker environment, you previously hit a wall because the underlying system lacked an automated hosting mechanism. ⟦Picture running a small warehouse without an automated scheduling system by having workers take manual shifts: although it will not automatically restart on crashes or launch on boot, it still keeps your current work running smoothly.⟧ When running `remote-control start` on Linux machines without a systemd user service manager (a program that manages background services for a user account), the daemon now starts directly as a background process, warning that the process will not restart on crash or launch on boot. You can enter `remote-control status` anytime to check its process ID (PID), and enter `remote-control stop` whenever you need to shut it down.

items.original: Improved `remote-control start` on Linux machines without a systemd user service manager, such as most containers: instead of failing, it now starts the daemon as a background process and warns that it will not restart after a crash or start at boot; `remote-control status` shows its PID and `remote-control stop` shuts it down

title.zh-TW: 長對話載入更快，缺步歷程不再覆寫舊進度
title.en: Long Conversations Load Faster, and Histories with Missing Steps No Longer Overwrite Old Progress

body.zh-TW: 當你接續聊了很久的繁重工作階段，或是中途遇上當機想接回紀錄時，整個流程順暢且安心許多。⟦如同翻開厚重日記時直接跳到最新的書籤頁，不必每次都從第一頁逐字掃描，就算中間曾掉了一頁，後續記錄也絕不會錯位覆蓋。⟧重啟擁有數千步驟的對話時，命令列介面不再預先逐步掃描，載入速度明顯加快。歷程若曾因當機或寫入中斷而出現遺漏步驟，恢復時不會再隱藏最新內容，更不會讓新訊息意外覆寫舊紀錄。自動產生的對話標題現在也會將首則訊息附加的圖片與檔案納入考量，純傳截圖或檔案的請求也能擁有具體的標題。
body.en: When you resume a heavy, long-running session or reconnect to your history after a crash, the entire workflow is noticeably smoother and safer. ⟦A reader opening a thick journal jumps straight to the newest bookmarked page without scanning word-by-word from the start, ensuring later entries never misalign or overwrite old notes even if a page went missing.⟧ When restarting conversations with thousands of steps, the command-line interface no longer pre-scans step-by-step, significantly speeding up load times. If history was missing steps due to crashes or interrupted writes, resuming will no longer hide the latest content, nor will new messages accidentally overwrite old records. Auto-generated conversation titles now also factor in images and files attached to the first message, giving concrete titles to requests that only include screenshots or files.

items.original:
Improved loading long conversations: resuming a conversation with thousands of steps is noticeably faster because the CLI no longer scans every step up front
Improved automatically generated conversation titles to take images and files attached to your first message into account, so screenshot- or file-driven requests get specific titles and messages with only attachments get a title too
Fixed resuming a conversation whose history had a missing step, for example after a crash or an interrupted write, hiding the most recent steps and letting new messages overwrite them

title.zh-TW: 帳號違規遭封鎖時，登入錯誤提示附上申訴連結
title.en: Login Error Prompts Include Appeal Links When Accounts Are Blocked for Violations

body.zh-TW: 早上一開工卻被擋在門外，畫面上只寫著因違反服務條款（Terms of Service）遭到停權，常讓人不知道該去哪裡詢問。以前遇到帳號受阻只能看見失敗提示，摸不清該找誰處理；現在登入失敗的錯誤訊息裡會直接附上申訴連結，讓你能立刻點擊網址提交說明。⟦就像門禁卡突然失效時，感應機不再只發出逼逼警告聲，而是直接在螢幕上顯示管理室的服務電話與分機。⟧
body.en: Starting your morning only to find yourself locked out, with a screen stating your account has been suspended for violating the Terms of Service, often leaves you wondering where to turn. Previously, encountering a blocked account only showed a generic failure message with no clear contact point; now, login failure error messages directly include an appeal link, letting you click the URL immediately to submit an explanation. ⟦Instead of merely beeping when an access card fails, a card reader now displays the management office phone number and extension directly on its screen.⟧

items.original: Improved the sign-in error shown to accounts blocked for a Terms of Service violation, which now includes a link to submit an appeal

title.zh-TW: `--json-schema` 啟動時嚴格檢查，根層級非物件立即報錯
title.en: `--json-schema` Strictly Validated at Startup, Failing Immediately If Root Level Is Not an Object

body.zh-TW: 當你為指令傳入結構描述時，若格式有誤或檔案遺失，系統在啟動階段就會立即攔截。⟦好比海關在登機門前嚴格核對護照格式，發現拿的是白紙、寫錯代碼或缺件就當場拒絕通行，而不是放行登機後才引發混亂。⟧參數 `--json-schema` 不再將純文字、單獨型態名稱（如 `string`）或不存在的結構描述檔默默當成字串型態處理。現在只要輸入上述無效內容，或是根層級不是物件（`"type": "object"`）的結構描述，程式在啟動時就會直接輸出錯誤訊息並以結束代碼 `1` 中斷退出。
body.en: When you pass a schema to a command, the system now intercepts formatting errors or missing files right at startup. ⟦Customs officers strictly check passport formats at the boarding gate, turning away blank paper, mistyped codes, or missing documents on the spot rather than causing chaos after boarding.⟧ The `--json-schema` parameter no longer silently treats plain text, bare type names (such as `string`), or non-existent schema files as string types. Supplying any of these invalid inputs, or a schema whose root level is not an object (`"type": "object"`), now causes the program to output an error message at startup and exit immediately with exit code `1`.

items.original: Changed `--json-schema` to reject plain text, bare type names such as `string`, and missing schema files instead of silently treating them as a string schema; these inputs, and any schema whose root is not `"type": "object"`, now fail at startup with an error and exit code `1`

title.zh-TW: 輸入提示不再游標偏離，表情符號與特殊文字換行不割裂
title.en: Prompt Input Eliminates Cursor Drift, Keeping Emojis and Complex Characters Intact Across Line Wraps

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入特殊字元或在多重視窗中作業時，游標位置與文字折行現在能精準對齊。⟦就像使用排版工具編輯圖文，以前遇到複雜貼圖或組合文字時游標會飄到半空中、換行還會把圖案切成兩半，現在游標與字元邊界都緊緊貼合。⟧修復了在提示列輸入 ⚠️ 或 👩‍💻 等表情符號，以及天城文（Devanagari）與泰文等組合字元時游標尾端偏離的問題，特別是在 `tmux` 環境下更是如此。當文字過長自動折行時，也不會再將這類特殊字元拆散切成兩行顯示。
body.en: When entering special characters in the terminal or working across multiplexed windows, cursor positioning and text wrapping now align precisely. ⟦Like laying out text and graphics in a publishing tool where complex stickers previously floated the cursor into mid-air and line breaks sliced graphics in half, the cursor and character boundaries now fit tightly together.⟧ Fixed trailing cursor drift when entering emojis such as ⚠️ or 👩‍💻, as well as combining characters like Devanagari and Thai in the prompt line, especially inside `tmux` environments. When long text wraps automatically, it will also no longer split these special characters across two lines.

items.original: Fixed the prompt cursor drifting away from the end of the text after emoji such as ⚠️ or 👩‍💻, or scripts with combining marks such as Devanagari and Thai, especially inside `tmux`, and fixed prompt wrapping splitting such characters across two lines

title.zh-TW: 檢視管線裝置與損毀影音不再卡死，事前攔截並清楚提示
title.en: Inspecting Pipe Devices and Corrupted Media No Longer Hangs, Intercepting Early with Clear Prompts

body.zh-TW: 當助理嘗試讀取特殊系統檔案或不完整的影音錄影時，對話不會再陷入無止境的等待或報錯。⟦宛如播放器遇到未下載完成的影片或特殊資料通道時直接提示檔案損毀，而不是整台機器當機轉圈圈。⟧以前助理若嘗試檢視管線（pipe）、通訊端或裝置檔等特殊檔案，流程很容易直接卡死。檢視未錄製完整的 MP4、MOV 或 M4A 影音檔時，對話也會陷入無效引數（`INVALID_ARGUMENT`）錯誤而無法繼續。現在遇到這兩類檔案時，系統會在讀取前直接攔截並給出明確的提示訊息。
body.en: When the assistant attempts to read special system files or incomplete audiovisual recordings, conversations no longer get trapped in endless waiting or error states. ⟦A media player encountering an incomplete video download or a special data stream alerts you to file corruption directly instead of freezing the entire machine with a spinning wheel.⟧ Previously, if the assistant tried to inspect special files such as pipes, sockets, or device files, the process easily hung completely. Inspecting incompletely recorded MP4, MOV, or M4A media files also threw `INVALID_ARGUMENT` errors that blocked the conversation from continuing. When encountering either type of file, the system now intercepts before reading and provides a clear prompt.

items.original: Fixed the agent hanging when it tried to view a pipe, socket, or device file, and a conversation getting stuck with `INVALID_ARGUMENT` errors after the agent viewed a truncated MP4, MOV, or M4A recording; both are now rejected up front with a clear message

title.zh-TW: 遇到模型限流聰明等待，額度耗盡立刻停手
title.en: Smarter Retry Delays on Rate Limits, Immediate Stop When Quota Exhausted

body.zh-TW: 若是頻繁發問而觸發了雲端模型的呼叫頻率限制，命令列工具現在會更聰明地處理重新嘗試的時間。以前只要遇到 API（程式與雲端模型溝通的管道）回傳需要稍候重試，工具一律死板地固定等待五秒。現在它會完全照著伺服器要求的秒數等待。如果伺服器要求等待超過三十秒，或是回報每日額度與帳單上限已滿，工具便會立刻停止執行，不再盲目重試。⟦跟到熱門餐廳抽號碼牌一樣，以前不管店家告知要等多久，你都每隔五秒就上前敲一次門；現在店家說等幾秒就精確等幾秒，若店家告知要等超過三十秒或當日名額已滿，則會立刻轉身離開不再徒勞敲門。⟧
body.en: If frequent prompts trigger cloud model rate limits, the command-line tool now handles retry delays more intelligently. Previously, whenever the API returned a retry-after response, the tool rigidly waited for a fixed five seconds. Now, it waits for the exact number of seconds requested by the server. If the server requests a delay of more than thirty seconds, or reports that the daily quota or billing limit is exhausted, the tool stops immediately instead of retrying blindly. ⟦Think of taking a number at a popular restaurant: in the past, no matter how long the staff told you to wait, you knocked on the door every five seconds; now you wait for the exact duration requested, and if they tell you the wait exceeds thirty seconds or that daily capacity is full, you turn away immediately without knocking in vain.⟧

items.original: Improved rate-limit handling when the model API returns a retry delay: the CLI now waits the delay the server asks for instead of a fixed 5 seconds, and stops right away instead of retrying when the delay is longer than 30 seconds or the quota is a daily or billing cap

title.zh-TW: 提升對話畫面繪製效能，捲動與運作時更省資源
title.en: Improved Chat Screen Rendering Performance for Lower Resource Usage While Scrolling

body.zh-TW: 在快速捲動落落長的對話紀錄、或看著代理人（代你執行任務的 AI）忙碌時，介面操作現在感覺更加輕快。對話畫面在重新繪製時的效能獲得了改善。以前每當畫面快速重繪，電腦的處理器（負責執行所有運算的核心硬體）使用率容易飆高，記憶體也會頻繁配置與釋放。現在無論是快速捲動視窗還是等待代理人即時輸出，都能有效減少運算資源耗損與記憶體負擔。⟦彷彿速寫畫家連畫好幾頁，以前很快就累了，畫紙也用得快；現在畫同樣多頁，力氣與畫紙都省下不少。⟧
body.en: When quickly scrolling through lengthy conversation histories or watching an agent work, UI interactions now feel significantly snappier. Redrawing performance for the conversation screen has been improved. Previously, rapid screen repaints often spiked CPU usage and caused frequent memory allocations and releases. Now, whether scrolling quickly through the window or waiting for real-time agent output, compute overhead and memory pressure are both substantially reduced. ⟦Picture a sketch artist drawing several pages in a row: in the past, the artist quickly grew tired and burned through paper; now, drawing that same number of pages takes far less effort and saves plenty of paper.⟧

items.original: Improved rendering efficiency, cutting CPU use and memory churn while the conversation view redraws, such as during fast scrolling or while the agent is working

title.zh-TW: 產物檢視器按鍵提示更明確，切換模式一目了然
title.en: Clearer Key Hints in the Artifact Viewer for Intuitive Mode Toggling

body.zh-TW: 想要預覽 AI 生成的圖表或公式等產物（獨立生成的圖表、公式或文件檔案）時，底部切換顯示模式的提示變得更直覺了。以前畫面上的 `m` 按鍵提示只寫 `toggle ASCII` 或 `toggle raw`，讓人難以預期切換後的畫面。現在提示文字會直接寫出內容種類與目標模式，例如清楚標示 `diagram ASCII`、`diagram source` 或是 `math image`。⟦好比相機上的功能轉盤，以前上面的標籤只寫著模糊的切換，轉過去才知道會變成什麼；現在清楚標示人像或夜景，按下去前就能明確知道切換後的樣貌。⟧
body.en: When previewing AI-generated artifacts such as standalone diagrams, formulas, or document files, the bottom hint for toggling display modes is now much more intuitive. Previously, the on-screen `m` key hint only displayed `toggle ASCII` or `toggle raw`, making it hard to anticipate what the screen would switch to. Now, the prompt text explicitly shows the content type and target mode, clearly indicating options like `diagram ASCII`, `diagram source`, or `math image`. ⟦Like a mode dial on a camera where labels previously showed a vague toggle so you only discovered the outcome after turning it, the dial now clearly marks portrait or night scene so you know the exact result before switching.⟧

items.original: Improved the artifact viewer's `m` hint to name the content and the mode it switches to, such as `diagram ASCII`, `diagram source`, or `math image`, instead of `toggle ASCII` or `toggle raw`

title.zh-TW: 窄終端機視窗文字不再被截斷，長行與標籤自動排版
title.en: Text No Longer Truncated in Narrow Terminal Windows with Auto-Wrapping for Long Lines and Tabs

body.zh-TW: 把終端機視窗縮小到約 40 欄寬的狹窄寬度時，各個功能面板的文字再也不會因為超出邊界而被裁切。以前在工作區信任對話框、`/help` 說明面板，以及登入與 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）驗證畫面中，長文字容易直接消失在螢幕邊緣。現在這些畫面中的長行文字與操作導引提示都會自動折行顯示，`/help` 的分頁標籤列也會自動緊縮排版以完整容納，排版截斷問題已經修好。
body.en: When shrinking a terminal window down to a narrow width of around 40 columns, text in various panels is no longer clipped by boundary overflows. Previously, in workspace trust dialogs, the `/help` panel, and login or MCP authentication screens, long text frequently disappeared off the edge of the screen. Now, long lines and guidance prompts across these screens wrap automatically, and the tab bar in `/help` compresses its layout to fit completely, fixing text truncation issues.

items.original: Fixed the workspace trust dialog, the `/help` panel, and the sign-in and MCP authentication screens clipping text on narrow terminals of around 40 columns; long lines and navigation hints now wrap, and the `/help` tab bar compacts to fit

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕捲動效能升級，長對話與檢視器不再卡頓
title.en: Smoother Full-Screen Scrolling Eliminates Stutter in Long Chats and Artifact Viewer

body.zh-TW: 當你在全螢幕模式下翻閱篇幅很長的對話紀錄，或是打開產出物檢視器查閱內容時，快速滑動滾輪與觸控板變得十分滑順。以前手指快速滾動時，每一次細微的滾輪訊號都會立即觸發畫面重新繪製，不僅容易造成畫面卡頓，還會佔用大量處理器（CPU，電腦負責運算的核心）資源。現在系統會先將短時間內連續觸發的滑動事件合併整理，再一次性更新畫面，既降低了運算負擔，也消除了操作延遲。⟦如同收發室把同一時間寄達的零散信件整批捆好一次遞交，不必每來一張明信片就專程跑一趟辦公室。⟧
body.en: Rapid scrolling with a mouse wheel or trackpad is now much smoother when browsing lengthy conversation histories or inspecting content in the artifact viewer in full-screen mode. Previously, every tiny scroll event triggered an immediate screen redraw during fast scrolling, which caused visual stutter and consumed heavy CPU resources. The system now batches scroll events triggered in rapid succession before updating the screen all at once, reducing computational overhead and eliminating lag. ⟦Picture a mailroom bundling scattered letters that arrive at the same time into a single delivery, rather than running to an office for every individual postcard.⟧

items.original: Improved scrolling in the full-screen view: bursts of mouse-wheel or trackpad events are now coalesced before redrawing, which cuts CPU use and reduces scroll lag in long conversations and the artifact viewer

title.zh-TW: 額度或預算耗盡立即停損，不再空等數分鐘重試
title.en: Immediate Fail-Fast on Exhausted Quota or Budget Without Minutes of Retrying

body.zh-TW: 使用金鑰 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 進行操作時，一旦帳戶額度見底，系統會立即中斷並回報，不再讓你乾等。以前只要遇到每日配額（quota，平台允許呼叫的使用上限）耗盡、專案或帳單達到支出上限，或是預付餘額扣光，程式仍會花費數分鐘持續重試不可能成功的連線。現在遇到這類確定無法解決的狀況會立刻中止工作階段。至於每分鐘呼叫次數超標這類短暫限制，仍會自動重試。⟦好比去自動販賣機買飲料，發現卡片餘額不足時機器會立刻提示餘額為零，而不是反覆吞吐卡片空轉好幾分鐘。⟧
body.en: When operating with `GEMINI_API_KEY`, the system now halts immediately and reports the error once your account quota is exhausted, sparing you from waiting idly. Previously, when hitting daily quotas, project or billing spend limits, or running out of prepaid credits, the application would still spend several minutes retrying connections that could not possibly succeed. The session now terminates immediately upon encountering these permanently unresolvable conditions. Transient restrictions such as exceeding rate limits per minute will still be retried automatically. ⟦A vending machine immediately alerts you to a zero balance when your card lacks sufficient funds, rather than repeatedly ejecting and swallowing the card for minutes.⟧

items.original: Improved `GEMINI_API_KEY` sessions to stop immediately when the Gemini API reports an exhausted daily quota, a project or billing-account spend cap, or depleted prepaid credits, instead of spending several minutes on retries that cannot succeed; short-lived per-minute rate limits are still retried

title.zh-TW: 重新接續長對話瞬間載入，跳過重複動畫不再卡頓
title.en: Instant Resumption for Long Sessions Skips Replay Animations Without Lag

body.zh-TW: 當你打開先前篇幅很長的工作階段繼續提問時，畫面載入的速度變得俐落許多。以前在 `medium` 或 `low` 的詳細程度（verbosity，決定畫面要印出多少除錯與執行細節的設定）下恢復對話時，系統需要花上數秒重播所有歷史紀錄，造成操作延遲。現在先前執行完畢的工具會直接顯示為完成狀態，省去逐條重播動畫的時間。在載入過程中敲擊鍵盤，也不會再重新整理只載入到一半的對話紀錄。⟦就像翻開已寫好的會議紀錄，大家能直接從結論處接著討論，不必把每位發言者的發言逐字重唸一遍。⟧
body.en: Loading feels much crisper when reopening a lengthy prior session to continue asking questions. Previously, resuming a conversation under `medium` or `low` verbosity required several seconds to replay entire histories, causing UI lag. Previously completed tools now render directly in their finished state, skipping sequential animation replays. Typing on the keyboard during loading also no longer refreshes a conversation history that has only partially loaded. ⟦Think of opening completed meeting minutes where everyone resumes discussion directly from the conclusion, without reading every attendee's remarks aloud word for word.⟧

items.original: Fixed resuming a long conversation in `medium` or `low` verbosity taking many seconds and lagging while history replayed: earlier tool groups now appear already finished instead of each re-animating, and keys pressed during the replay no longer refresh a half-loaded transcript

title.zh-TW: 終端機多工器標題不再亂碼，修復圖片探測干擾
title.en: Terminal Multiplexer Titles Preserved Without Mojibake From Graphics Probing

body.zh-TW: 在多窗格環境下啟動工具時，終端機與分頁的名稱終於能正常保留。以前在 GNU `screen`、`tmux`（包含 iTerm2 的 `tmux -CC` 分頁）或 Zellij 等環境中開啓命令列時，標題每次都會被改成 `Ga=q,f=32,...` 這類奇怪的字串。這是因為系統啟動時會發送圖片支援的探測訊號，因而干擾了終端機多工器（將終端視窗分割成多個獨立工作區的工具）。現在程式不再主動向多工器發送圖片探測指令。若你確定需要開啟圖片顯示，依然可透過設定 `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty` 強制啟用。⟦彷彿廣播系統取消了開場時刺耳的測試音，螢幕面板上的節目名稱再也不會被測試訊號給干擾覆蓋。⟧
body.en: Terminal and tab titles are now properly preserved when launching tools in multi-pane environments. Previously, opening the command line under GNU `screen`, `tmux` (including iTerm2 `tmux -CC` tabs), or Zellij altered window titles to strange strings like `Ga=q,f=32,...`. This occurred because the startup sequence sent graphics support probes, which interfered with terminal multiplexers. The program no longer sends graphics probes to multiplexers by default. If you still need image rendering, you can force it on by setting `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty`. ⟦Like a broadcast system silencing its harsh opening test tone, the show title on the display panel is no longer scrambled by test signals.⟧

items.original: Fixed the terminal or tab title changing to a string like `Ga=q,f=32,...` every time the CLI starts inside GNU `screen`, `tmux` (including iTerm2 `tmux -CC` tabs), or Zellij; the CLI no longer sends its image-support probe through a multiplexer, and `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty` still forces image mode

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式多項修正，支援中文字元搜尋與選取復原
title.en: Multiple Vim Mode Fixes Support Non-ASCII Character Search and Selection Undo

body.zh-TW: 偏好使用 Vim 模式編輯指令與文字的讀者，現在輸入非英文字元或選取段落時順手許多。以前在 `r`、`f`、`F`、`t` 與 `T` 指令後輸入 `é` 或 `中` 等非 ASCII 字元（非英文字母與標準符號的文字）時會被直接忽略。在可視模式（Visual mode，反白選取文字的模式）下使用 `fv` 與 `fV` 會意外跳出選取，無法順利延伸範圍。當執行 `D`、`C` 或可視狀態下的 `~`、`u`、`U` 但沒有變動文字時，以前還會多記一筆空白復原紀錄並清空重做歷程。現在這些編輯問題都已修正完畢。⟦宛如操作高階文書軟體，跳躍搜尋中文字能精確定位，反白選取時不會無故中斷，就算誤觸沒有作用的按鍵也不會清空復原歷程。⟧
body.en: Editing commands and text in Vim mode is now significantly smoother when typing non-English characters or selecting blocks. Previously, non-ASCII characters such as `é` or `中` were silently ignored after `r`, `f`, `F`, `t`, and `T` commands. Using `fv` and `fV` in Visual mode inadvertently exited the selection instead of extending the range. Furthermore, executing `D`, `C`, or Visual mode `~`, `u`, and `U` without modifying text recorded an empty undo entry and wiped the redo history. All of these editing glitches have now been resolved. ⟦Much like working in an advanced text editor, jumping to Chinese characters lands accurately, highlighting text does not abruptly cancel, and hitting ineffective keys will not wipe your redo history.⟧

items.original: Fixed Vim mode ignoring non-ASCII characters such as `é` or `中` after `r`, `f`, `F`, `t` and `T`, `fv` and `fV` in Visual mode leaving Visual mode instead of extending the selection, and `D`, `C`, or Visual `~`/`u`/`U` recording an empty undo step and clearing redo history when they changed nothing

title.zh-TW: 接回舊對話與狀態列即時提醒，快取過期成本一目了然
title.en: Resuming Old Conversations with Real-Time Status Line Alerts Makes Cache Expiration Costs Clear

body.zh-TW: 當你暫停工作後想接續先前任務，常因快取（暫存計算結果的機制）過期而重送大量資料。開啟進度管家後，只要以 `/resume`、`--resume` 或 `--continue` 接回過期且脈絡達 5 萬 token（AI 計費的文字單位）的對話，Claude Code 會在輸入首句前顯示一行提示，列出閒置時間、預估重送的 token 數並建議先執行 `/compact`。此提示僅自己可見且不計入脈絡，需 2.1.251 以上版本且下次啟動 usage 自動套用。狀態列在倒數結束後也不再留白，到期當下會即時重畫，顯示如 `cold·re-cache 180k` 的提示，表示下一則訊息約有 18 萬 token 要重新快取。⟦如同退房時櫃檯即時試算加時費用，以前超時往往結帳才發現驚人帳單，現在一到超時點就主動亮出補收標準，讓你能提前評估是否精簡內容。⟧
body.en: When resuming previous tasks after taking a break, users often resend large amounts of data due to expired caches. With Progress Manager enabled, whenever you resume an expired conversation with at least 50k tokens of context using `/resume`, `--resume`, or `--continue`, Claude Code displays a single-line notice before you enter your first prompt. This notice details the idle duration and the estimated number of tokens to resend, while suggesting that you run `/compact` first. Visible only to you, this prompt is excluded from context, requires version 2.1.251 or later, and applies automatically the next time usage launches. The status line also no longer goes blank when the countdown ends. Instead, it redraws immediately upon expiration to show prompts like `cold·re-cache 180k`, indicating that the next message will re-cache approximately 180k tokens. ⟦Picture a hotel front desk calculating overtime charges the moment checkout passes: instead of discovering a surprise bill at final settlement, you immediately see the extra fees and can decide in advance whether to trim your stay.⟧

items.original:
**Resuming a stale conversation now tells you what it will cost.** When Progress Concierge is on and you `/resume` (or `--resume` / `--continue`) a conversation whose prompt cache has expired and whose context is at least 50k tokens, Claude Code shows a one-line warning before your first message: how long it sat idle, roughly how many tokens the next message re-sends, and a suggestion to `/compact` first. Only you see it; it is never added to Claude's context. Needs Claude Code 2.1.251 or newer. Existing installs pick up the new trigger automatically the next time usage starts.
**The status line now says what a cold cache will cost.** Once the prompt cache countdown runs out, the segment switches to how many tokens the next message will re-cache (for example `cold·re-cache 180k`) instead of going blank. Claude Code redraws the status line the moment the cache expires, so no refresh interval is needed.

title.zh-TW: 額度快用完改播專屬短音，告急提醒更具辨識度
title.en: Distinct Chimes for Dwindling Quotas Make Low-Quota Alerts Instantly Recognizable

body.zh-TW: 埋頭趕工或專注思考時，如果沒有時常緊盯著用量面板，額度（特定週期內可使用的調用配額上限）見底的瞬間往往讓人猝不及防。現在系統調整了通知音效，當額度快用完或已經用完時，會改播 usage 自製的兩聲「uh-oh」簡短警示音，讓你光聽聲音就能分辨用量告急。至於額度恢復時的通知，則繼續維持播放系統預設的提示音，避免干擾既有的使用習慣。⟦洗衣機遇到排水故障時用短促警示，洗好衣服則播放一般完成音；現在額度告急有專屬短音，額度恢復仍是系統預設音，光聽就能分辨。⟧
body.en: When rushing through work or deep in thought, running out of quota without watching the usage popover can easily catch you off guard. The system has now updated its notification sounds. Whenever quota is running low or fully exhausted, usage plays a custom two-tone "uh-oh" short alert, letting you recognize the urgent status by sound alone. Notifications for quota recovery continue to play the default system chime, preserving your established workflow habits. ⟦A washing machine beeps with a sharp warning when drainage fails but plays a standard completion chime when the cycle finishes smoothly. In the same way, quota exhaustion now triggers a dedicated short tone while recovery uses the default system sound, making them distinguishable by ear alone.⟧

items.original: Quota warning and quota-depleted notifications now play a short two-note "uh-oh" alert sound made for usage. The quota-restored notification keeps the system default sound.

title.zh-TW: 修正子代理輸出少算問題，歷史快取自動重新結算
title.en: Fixing Undercounted Subagent Outputs and Automatically Recalculating Historical Caches

body.zh-TW: 習慣呼叫多個背景助手平行處理繁重任務的使用者，過去看到的用量統計可能嚴重失真。先前在串流（答案一邊生成一邊逐字傳輸的輸出方式）處理時，Claude Code 會把同一請求多次寫入日誌，導致解析器只抓到第一行，使子代理的輸出用量少算約 86%。例如在某台機器上的 17 個子代理日誌中，原本僅記錄到 23,327 個輸出 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位），修正後改取每筆請求的最大值，實際數值應為 165,395。這項問題只影響子代理，主對話日誌完全不受影響；更新後歷史快取與年度快取會自動重算一次，但日誌已遭刪除的日期則維持封存數字無法補正。⟦好比收銀機結帳時印出整串明細，以前系統只抓取了剛開始印出的第一行小計，導致整筆交易總額嚴重短少；現在改以最終印出的加總金額為準，歷史紀錄重新結算後用量數字終於回歸真實。⟧
body.en: Users accustomed to spawning multiple background assistants for parallel tasks may have previously seen severely skewed usage statistics. During streaming responses, Claude Code wrote the same request to logs multiple times. This caused the parser to capture only the first line, undercounting subagent output usage by about 86%. For example, across 17 subagent logs on one machine, only 23,327 output tokens were initially recorded; after switching to taking the maximum value per request, the actual count was 165,395. This issue affected only subagents, leaving main session logs completely untouched. After the update, historical and annual caches are automatically recalculated once, though dates whose logs were deleted remain archived and cannot be retroactively fixed. ⟦Think of a cash register printing a long receipt where the system previously captured only the first line of subtotal, causing the recorded total to fall drastically short. By taking the final printed sum instead, historical records are recalculated and usage numbers reflect reality at last.⟧

items.original: **Claude subagent output was undercounted by about 86%.** Claude Code writes each subagent request to its transcript several times while it streams, and `output_tokens` only reaches its final value on the last line. Both Claude parsers kept the first line, so on one machine 17 subagent transcripts counted 23,327 output tokens instead of 165,395. They now keep the largest value for each request. Main-conversation transcripts were not affected. The history and yearly caches are rebuilt once; days whose transcripts were already deleted keep their archived totals and cannot be corrected.

title.zh-TW: 離線備用價目表補上 Sonnet 5.5，名稱顯示不再截斷
title.en: Offline Fallback Pricing Adds Sonnet 5.5 and Fixes Truncated Model Names

body.zh-TW: 遇到網路斷線或離線環境工作時，最怕計費工具因連不上伺服器而無法正確計算新型號的花費。現在離線備援（主要機制失效時接手的後備清單）價目表正式補上了新模型資料，完整納入 `claude-sonnet-5-5` 的費率。以前當下載的線上價目表過期時，這款模型的用量會被誤算為 0 美元；現在即使離線也能依正確標準計價，終端機表格中也會顯示為清晰的「Sonnet 5.5」，不再出現被截斷的模型識別碼。⟦彷彿隨身攜帶的紙本價目表補齊了最新熱門品項，以前網路斷線時查不到新餐點價格會直接被當成免費招待，現在備援清單完整對齊，就算離線結算也不會漏算費用。⟧
body.en: When working offline or during network outages, cost tracking tools often fail to price new models accurately without server access. The offline fallback pricing table now officially incorporates new model data, fully including rates for `claude-sonnet-5-5`. Previously, when the downloaded online pricing expired, usage for this model was miscalculated as $0. Now it is priced correctly even offline, and terminal tables clearly display "Sonnet 5.5" rather than a truncated model identifier. ⟦Like a printed menu updated with the newest popular dishes, where disconnected servers previously treated unknown items as free on the house, the fallback list is now fully aligned so offline calculations never miss a charge.⟧

items.original: Add Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`) to the offline fallback price table, so its usage is no longer priced at $0 when the downloaded price table is stale, and show it as "Sonnet 5.5" in tables instead of a truncated model ID.

title.zh-TW: 心電圖面板字級對齊其他主題，專案明細不再偏小
